description: Na₄TaGa(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.44 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.96 Å) and three longer (2.03 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) Ga-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ga, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent ONa₃TaSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃TaSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃TaSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent ONa₃TaSi trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
